#   ⟨62⟩ G1 BrainCo Pick Datasets — 2x speed, 24fps 
All 8 pick/grasp tasks in one repo, one subfolder each. Derived from `unitreerobotics/G1_Brainco_*_Dataset`⟨63⟩ (via the GR00T-ready conversion in `dataset_g1/brainco_pick/`), resampled to a literal **2x playback speed** and **24fps** for training a joint video+action Cosmos Policy world model (image + language prompt in, video + action out).
##   ⟨57⟩ Why 2x / 24fps 
Source teleop demos are 30fps at real robot speed. Cosmos 3 trains predominantly at 24fps, and NVIDIA's own Cosmos Policy paper downsamples ALOHA demonstration data 50Hz -> 25Hz ("reduce the controller frequency ... for computational efficiency") — the same move applied here.
##   ⟨58⟩ Transform 
  * **Video** : `ffmpeg -vf "setpts=0.5*PTS,fps=24"` — halves all timestamps (literal 2x speed, motion unchanged just compressed in time), then resamples to a clean 24fps constant-frame-rate stream.
  * **State/action/timestamp rows** : resampled with the matching nearest-neighbor mapping so every video frame lines up 1:1 with its action/state row. Verified frame-exact (parquet row count == video frame count) across every episode and all 3 camera views, for every task below.
  * `stats.json` / `relative_stats.json` regenerated fresh from the resampled data via `gr00t/data/stats.py` (not copied from the source).


##   ⟨59⟩ Format 
GR00T-ready LeRobot v2.1 per-episode format, same schema across all 8 tasks:
  * **State** (26D): `arm_q` [0:14] bimanual arm joints + `hand_state` [14:26] BrainCo finger states
  * **Action** (26D, ABSOLUTE joint targets): `arm_q` [0:14] + `hand_cmd` [14:26]
  * **Cameras** : `head_stereo_left`, `wrist_left`, `wrist_right` (h264, 640x480, 24fps)

##   ⟨61⟩ Use with GR00T / Cosmos Policy training 

```
bash examples/finetune.sh \
  --base-model-path nvidia/GR00T-N1.7-3B \
  --dataset-path dataset_g1/brainco_pick_2x/G1_Brainco_PickApple_Dataset \
  --embodiment-tag NEW_EMBODIMENT \
  --modality-config-path examples/G1_Brainco/g1_brainco_pick_config.py \
  --output-dir outputs/pickapple_2x24fps

```

Swap the `--dataset-path` for any of the 8 subfolder names above.
Conversion script: `examples/G1_Brainco/resample_brainco_pick_2x24fps.py` in NVIDIA-Omniverse/Isaac-GR00T⟨64⟩.
